description: Sent when a user enables or signs in with email-based multi-factor authentication on the Sixth Form System. Carries a single-use 6-digit code that expires after a few minutes.
subject: Your {{system_name}} verification code: {{code}}
body:
Hi {{username}},

Use the verification code below to finish signing in to {{system_name}}:

    {{code}}

This code will expire in {{expiry_minutes}} minutes and can only be used once.

If you didn't ask for this code, you can safely ignore this email — your account stays locked without it. If you keep getting codes you didn't request, please change your password and tell a member of the IT or safeguarding team straight away.

For your security, never share this code with anyone — not staff, not classmates, not over the phone.

Thanks,
The {{system_name}} Security Team
